rca of the issue: Bug 1 root cause: MP-Individual Manufactured per-component pricing loop in engine_routes.py priced every qty row at slot_index=0, so the runner's _resolve_misc_per_slot(miscCharges, 0) only ever returned costByQty[0]. Fix: pass the real loop index slot_i (and item_qtys[slot_i]) so each tier resolves its own override. Bug 2 root cause: ComponentSubTable row click only updated local selRowByComp state; the right rail reads s.selSlot + activeItemIdx so it never refreshed. Fix: onSelectRow now also calls switchBomItem(c.itemIndex) (when changing component) and setField('selSlot', compRows[idx].slotIdx). Both fixes verified to the cent — no regressions observed in section header totals, Quote Summary, or Preview PDF modal.
